fields.title: 6. Proposed new rules — none
fields.md:
R2 already covers Ship recovery. However, the definition of "recovery success" is fixed as the first task of the next run, before the result is known. If the definition is chosen after seeing the result, the rule bends to fit the result. The loss of the booster is background for reuse economics, but it has no numbers and is therefore not a subject for a rule. Existing proposals ①–⑤ are kept (source: `state.rule_proposals_not_applied`).
